_comment: Places nullrpc does not serve. Read by the zone WAF rule and by nullrpc-app (sign-in and payments, from request.cf). Countries are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; regions are ISO 3166-2 subdivisions: Crimea (UA-43), Sevastopol (UA-40), Donetsk (UA-14) and Luhansk (UA-09). Syria stays listed while counsel reviews the 2025 US/EU easing. Russia and Belarus are not listed: they are subject to sectoral, not comprehensive, sanctions (counsel decision).
